decisions.base: All 660 Base cards equally likely, including Diamond Kings and Rated Rookies subsets.
decisions.puzzle: 21 distinct Roberto Clemente Puzzle three-piece panels, each inserted one per original wax pack.
decisions.excluded: Wax box-bottom panel/singles and mail-in Super Diamond Kings 5x7 were not ordinary pack-issued cards.
decisions.variationPolicy: Collapse wax/factory back orientations and error/correction variations to one collectible per number; preserve printed subjects.
decisions.rookiePolicy: Independently verify TCDB Rookie Cards list (250 variant entries, deduplicated by card number), mark only verified true rookie subjects RC.
decisions.pack: VCS four-card packs, 24 packs per box; puzzle historical 1:1 per wax pack (pending VCS odds review).
decisions.release: Unreleased pending card images, packaging, pricing, team/rookie and rarity QA.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Includes Diamond Kings and Rated Rookies; back orientation varieties collapse.

productSets.name: Roberto Clemente Puzzle
productSets.notes: Three-piece puzzle panels, #1-3 through #61-63, one panel per physical wax pack.
